stage1.title: Hello there.
stage1.subtitle: Your name, then a short climb.

pre.title: Meet AI Global
pre.body:
AI Global @ MIT. Practitioners treating AI as a craft — open to everyone. Backed by MIT Professional Education.

Mission: open systems, practical AI, clear stewardship.

Each quarter the community goes deep on one domain — Q1 2026 is marketing. Case studies (GenMRKT), courses (SPC), peer-reviewed papers, and live sessions drop alongside the always-on AI for All work.

Now — 100 m climb. Falling is fine.

stage1.ctaHint: 100 m. We'll hint the first few holds.
stage1.mantra: One quarter · one domain · real systems.

fall.title: Fall card · The loop catches you
fall.body: AI Global runs on cycles. A miss is part of the run — pick up, climb again. The lesson stays.

stage2.title: Your first intro
stage2.subtitle: One line you'd actually post in Discord.

pre.title: The Discord, briefly
pre.body:
The community lives on a Discord server called AI Global. First stop is #👋introduce-yourself — name, country, role, why you're here.

Pick a lane below; we'll draft a line. Shuffle or write your own.

Right now: GloLabs Vol 1 just dropped — six peer-reviewed marketing case studies.

stage2.ctaHint: Same wall, no hints this time. You've got this.
stage2.shareLine: AI Global goes deep on one domain each quarter. Q1 2026: marketing.

outcome.winBody: Your intro is ready to post. Drop it into #👋introduce-yourself — people there are quick to ❤️ and reply.
outcome.failBody: The intro is still ready — post it anyway, then come back for another go. Falling is part of the climb.

stage3.title: Find your buddy
stage3.subtitle: The longer post. We'll format it for you.

pre.title: How buddies work
pre.body:
#🤝find-a-buddy uses a structured format. Fill the form below; we'll produce a copy-paste-ready post.

Two more programs to know: SPC (four hands-on governance courses) · Projects (Ambassador, AI.MRKT, AI 2027). Volunteer in any.

stage3.ctaHint: No target. Just go as high as you can.
stage3.mantra: I'd teach X · I'd learn Y.
stage3.shareLine: The Discord routes you to a buddy in your lane.

outcome.posterBody: Your buddy post is ready. Drop it in #find-a-buddy — you'll have replies by morning.
outcome.lovedPrompt: Optional — one line about what hooked you. Lives on the poster.
outcome.next: One more game in Stage 4 — how a neural net actually learns.

stage4.title: One more game
stage4.subtitle: How a neural net actually learns.
stage4.body:
GloGames' first release. Six floors: Inputs → Weights → Neurons → Activation → Loss → the loop. ~10 minutes.

GloGames is one of three publication streams alongside GloLabs (case studies) and SPC (courses).

stage5.title: What's next
stage5.subtitle: When the cycle rolls.
stage5.body:
Reserved for Q2. New game, new domain, new ways to contribute.

By the numbers: 11K+ taught · 200+ upskilled · 1K+ members in 4 weeks · 80%+ weekly active. The energy is real.

See you when the cycle rolls.
